data.text: Until end of round, no one may deal damage to adjacent tiles and your tile. Channel: draw Fire token every action.

logic.description: Implemented as a channel (general_ux_channeling, 2026-10-29). The no-damage zone over my tile and its neighbours is renewed every action while I keep the Fire channel; a Fire bonus token goes on my tile. ∀: instant.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

general_ux_channeling: the channel stands while the caster neither Attacks, Blocks, Moves, Empty-Moves nor emits an element other than the cost element; any of those breaks it and the permanent falls.

effects.description: The caster hex and its six neighbours become a no-damage zone until the end of the turn.

Every subsequent action the channel re-fires its leg (the no-damage zone on my tile and its six neighbours + a Fire bonus token on my tile) with the caster's current stats, at no further cost, until broken.
The channel permanent stands on the SMALLEST die of its placement roll (Rule 24 threshold).

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_fire (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The ∀ double-cast bonus text stays present (the engine unlocks it on a Rule 23 chained cast).
